title: Post Processor + Print-to-Program Autopilots
brief: Post processor chain: controller detection, template selection, generation, verification. Print-to-program chain: drawing interpretation, process planning, toolpath, G-code generation. Agent team coordination with existing forge-team/pipeline-team patterns.

units.title: Implement controller detection chain: identify CNC controller from user input or drawing metadata
Implement template selection and post processor generation chain: match controller to template, generate post processor code
Implement post processor verification chain: syntax validation, G-code output spot-check, known-good comparison
Implement drawing interpretation chain: extract dimensions, tolerances, features from drawing input
Implement process planning and toolpath chain: operation sequencing, tool selection, toolpath strategy
Wire agent team coordination: dispatch to forge-team/pipeline-team patterns for multi-step generation and review

exit_conditions: Post processor chain: controller detect -> template select -> generate -> verify working end-to-end
Print-to-program chain: drawing interpret -> process plan -> toolpath -> G-code working end-to-end
Agent team coordination dispatches correctly to forge-team/pipeline-team
Both chains produce verifiable outputs with quality checks
